name: applypilot
description: Local-first job application autopilot: truthful tailored resumes, screening answers and a duplicate-proof ledger.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck -w server && npm test -w server && npm run build -w web
